topic: Supracondylar fracture nerve and vessel documentation
usual_baseline: Under half have detailed nerve documentation. Compliance 45.8% [578], under 40% [583], 37.9% for individual nerves in ED [1437]. Anterior interosseous nerve worst, as low as 10% [1142]. Post-op nerve function documented in 9.7% [1437].
fix_that_works: A proforma, best built into clerking. Electronic pro forma took items from 10–53% to 86–95% [1142]. Paper proforma: under 40% to 70% [583]; 45.8% to 76.5% [578]; ED nerve function 37.9% to 72.7% [1437]. Consultant-led joint ED and orthopaedic teaching raised specific ED documentation 38.9% to 82.9% [1411].
fix_that_fails: A single teaching presentation: detailed neurological findings 38.8% to 54.2% (p=0.129) [1533]. 'NV intact' still used. After ED manipulation, 31.8% still had no documentation [1411]. Pre-op nerve function stayed low, 42.7% to 50% [1437].
consultant_advice: Done six times here with the same finding and the same fix. Don't repeat it. Audit documentation after manipulation and after surgery, which stayed poor, or check whether the proforma is still used a year on.
